lines.en: label halloweenfive12:
Miles from here...on the other side of town...
scene yumiinthelobbyyo1
: Yumi! I’m glad you finally made it! I kinda assumed you were just going to stay clocked out until your competition with Nodoka tomorrow.
: Hi. Yeah. Cool. Whatever. Anyone else here a time traveler?
scene yumiinthelobbyyo2
: A what now?
: Oh, no...You started doing drugs, didn’t you?
: No, I’m not on fuckin’ drugs, Chika. And that shit doesn’t really have the same impact it would’ve if I hadn’t said the same damn thing to you a few hours ago.
: But I haven’t seen you all day. You-
scene yumiinthelobbyyo3

: Yeah, to you it...I’m sure it probably seems that way. But for me, today’s been fuckin’ weird as hell. And just a little while ago, we were at some other party. One where you...somehow had even less clothing on.
: That sounds like a fun party to me. Imani keeps scolding me for “looking like a slut” though, so I’m not sure if we’d be able to invite her.
: Just to...make sure we’re all on the same page here...are you saying you somehow traveled through time to get here, Yumi?
scene yumiinthelobbyyo4
: Not on purpose! But yeah! That’s what fuckin’ happened!
: Yumi says I have a boyfriend in the timeline she comes from.
: Do I have a boyfriend where you come from?
: You have the same boyfriend. Now, are there any other questions you need to get out of your system or I can talk to four-eyes about this now?
: Yumi, I may be smart, but you’re overestimating me if you think I can just figure out the key to time travel in five minutes.
: Yeah, you’ll need to ask Nodoka if you want to figure it out that quickly. And I’m imagining that’s a no-go considering you beat the shit out of her not that long ago.
scene yumiinthelobbyyo5
: Also, hands off my make-believe boyfriend! If I can’t have one in this world, I’ll be damned if I share the one I actually do have in Yumi’s world!
: I’m sure you could get one easily if you’d just give up on Sensei already. You two have nothing in common. You don’t like football or Ami.
scene yumiinthelobbyyo6
: But he’s so hot! I probably just have to take more of my clothes off!
: Calming to know you’re still a fucking nutjob in both realities at least.
: Yumi, what’s going on here? You’re not the type to joke about something like this- especially with me of all people. So I’m inclined to believe you, but...
: Surely you understand how absolutely ridiculous this claim is, right?
scene yumiinthelobbyyo7
: Fuck yeah I do! But you were one of the people who fuckin’ taught me about this shit where I come from, so I figured you’d know here!
: If you don’t, I’m just gonna have to do all this shit over again! And this section was like the worst fuckin’ part of my high school life until recently!
: What happened recently?
: You did, you fuckin’ psycho! I had to fuckin’ hold onto the railing at your apartment for dear life or you would’ve fuckin’ pushed me over it.
: You should know better than anyone that my railing itself is already holding on for dear life. There’s no way it would protect you from me.
: Not the shitty old apartment, your fancy new one.
scene yumiinthelobbyyo8
: Damn. I’m doing pretty well in Yumi-world, huh?
: Maybe on paper...
: Chika, do you think this might have something to do with what Ayane was ranting about earlier?
scene yumiinthelobbyyo9
: Blondie?! Really?! What’d she say?! Because she’s supposed to be in on this shit too!
: Maybe she got sent back with me? Or maybe...everybody did since I think you guys are supposed to be interruptin’ me? You sure you ain’t got any memories of the...uh...future?
: I wish. Your future sounds awesome. But yeah, I think Makoto might be onto something with the Ayane situation. I’ve never seen her act that weird before.
: Weird how? But please leave out anything involving fucking slumber parties because she won’t fucking shut up about them and if that’s the only thing on her mind-
: She kinda just freaked out on Sensei and was, like...kind of accusing him of not being the same or something?
scene yumiinthelobbyyo10
: He, like...totally is though. Which isn’t to say I’m always watching him and thinking about him or anything. But yeah, I’d notice if he changed.
: Not...the same?
: It’d probably be better to talk to Ayane about it directly. She sort of stormed off with Maya once the “contest” was over, but I’m not sure where they went.
: Well then, how the fuck am I supposed to find her?
: So, there are these things called “cell phones” right-
scene yumiinthelobbyyo11
: You can use mine, Yumi. I doubt you have Ayane’s number saved. Come over here, though. I’d like to talk about this alone if that’s okay.
: It better not be about stealing my future boyfriend, you hear me? Because that’s the closest I’ve ever come to-
: Chika, just focus on bein’ a fuckin’ parent or whatever, okay? You ain’t ready for a relationship yet.
scene yumiinthelobbyyo12
: Wha- Yumi! Of course I’m ready! Just look at me! There are boys who would kill for a piece of this!
: Then go find one of them instead of our god damn teacher!
: Yumi, stop paying attention to her.
scene yumiinthelobbyyo13
: Focus on me instead.
: Sorry...long day and...

: Do you really not remember any of the shit we talked about earlier? About like...how bein’ wrapped up in this changes a person? Because I know that some memories get wiped out or whatever, but I don’t...
: I don’t really know what stays and what goes and...I’m pretty sure I remember fuckin’ everything. Least that’s how it seems to me.
: How far...into the future were you exactly? Do you know that much?
scene yumiinthelobbyyo14
: I don’t know...a couple years? But we were all still freshmen because the school year never actually ends or some shit? You were the one who knew this stuff, not me.
: And I was...dating Sensei in this timeline? That was what you were implying earlier, right?
scene yumiinthelobbyyo15
: What? Yeah, I guess. But is that really what’s important about the fact that I straight up teleported here from the future? Shit wasn’t even special. Dude was fucking like half the class.
: You know my dad died recently, right?
scene yumiinthelobbyyo16
: Uhh...yeah? And I know that sucks and all, but what’s it got to do with this?
scene yumiinthelobbyyo17
: I locked myself in my room for a while after that happened. I wasn’t really sure what to do...or how I was ever going to get better.

: And while I was locked up, I had these...dreams. Really vivid ones. Stuff like that has always been normal for me, but this time felt...off. Like I was looking back on something that hadn’t even happened yet.

: And in those dreams, it was like you said. Sensei was sleeping with the entire class. Chika was even more obsessive than she is now. And Sensei was...different. A lot more sad, if I had to put it into words.
: I was so miserable at the time that I kind of just shelved all of that and chalked it up to tragedy-induced delusions, but...I don’t know.
scene yumiinthelobbyyo18
: I know those minute details aren’t really enough to go off of and...I’m not saying that what you’ve supposedly experienced is definitely the same thing as what I saw and felt, but-

: Sorry, Makoto. Even if it was, I still don’t really know shit about you. Or anything for that matter. I just...got thrown into all this bullshit outta nowhere and never really learned what to do about it.
: I can relate to the...seein’ shit thing, though. I was like that back there. Had memories of shit that like, never happened and all that. Or maybe it did. Just...somewhere else.
: Yumi, I get that “time travel” has a lot of unwritten rules to it, so I’m not going to test the boundaries of them by asking you anything that might alter my actions in this world-
: Good cause I ain’t got a fuckin’ clue what you just said.
: I just want to know...
: Do I...ever get less sad?
scene yumiinthelobbyyo19
: Like...maybe with Sensei’s support, I can move past this. But I’m just so worried that this...emptiness is going to consume me. And I don’t want to not care anymore. I really don’t.
: I just...I have no idea how I’m supposed to...deal with that. So a simple yes or no will work. After that, I’ll...stop bothering you and just...wish you luck with however you want to approach this.
: If you don’t want to answer that, it’s fine. I get it.
: Yeah...
: Sorry, Makoto. I...
scene black
: I think that...has to be a thing you figure out yourself...
scene yumiinthelobbyyo20
: Miku! You still love me, don’t you? My best friend is being a total buzzkill right now.
: POV — you’re way too hot and everyone wants you.
: I’m...not sure if that’s the correct usage of “POV.” But I’m glad your confidence has increased tenfold, Miku! Even if it’s at the expense of your usual charm.
scene yumiinthelobbyyo21
: What do you mean “usual charm?!” Anything Miku traded away for this look is a win as far as I’m concerned! I hope she stays like this forever and lets me take her home and treat her like a doll.
: No cap, all this simping is giving me a new ick right now. I’m gonna need fam to cease. This ain’t bussin’ at all.
: Ahh... Music to my ears.
: I-I don’t mean I don’t like this Miku too! I just relate to the sportier, fun one a lot more! Which isn’t to say this one isn’t fun! I just...hahah! Miku!
scene yumiinthelobbyyo22
: Ugh. Yes, I ate. But y’all is tweaking over this glow up for real for real. Vibe check failed.
: You look super cute yourself, Karin. Maybe all three of us can hang out next weekend and I can gyaru-fy you next?
: Next weekend? I can’t. I’m supposed to go over to Sensei’s house to watch football.
scene yumiinthelobbyyo23
: What? Didn’t you just do that last week though?
: D...Did I? I don’t really remember...
: Football? More like Netflix and chill. If you know, you know.
scene yumiinthelobbyyo24
: I...I don’t. I have no idea what that means.
: Karin and Sensei?! No way! Not with Ami in the picture. I’m not buying.
: Bet. Karin secured that bag ages ago. Their situationship is why Sensei’s so Ohio now.
scene yumiinthelobbyyo25
: No.
: No what?! I only understand half of these words!
: Caught in 4k and she ain’t even know it. Real ones spill the tea. Honesty hits different Karin. Try it.
: T-T-Try what?!
scene yumiinthelobbyyo26
: S-S-S-S-Sensei and I are just football buddies! He’s just excited to have another girl around who knows what’s happening on the screen! It’s definitely nothing more than that!
scene yumiinthelobbyyo27

: I mean...how could it be with Ami being there literally every minute of every day and always watching us even if she doesn’t like football. Which doesn’t mean I don’t like Ami. I love Ami. Just...come on!
: It’s not like you have to sit between us or remove the locks on all of the doors or pretend to understand what’s going on or go through my phone whenever I come over and-
scene yumiinthelobbyyo28
: I’m just going to stop talking before I get in trouble.
: That whole rant was out of pocket af.
: Is...Is Karin the main character? Is Ami just a diversion?
: They both managed to out-rizz us. Karin just got slept on. Which means me and you are NPCs, Chika. Sensei’s sigma grindset got us shook.
: I can’t believe she even understood the assignment...
: I’m a good, innocent girl. I am normal. I am pure.
: Pluh.
scene yumiinthelobbyyo29
: Fuck! She still ain’t answerin’ and I’ve tried from both of our phones.
: You might just have to look for her the old fashioned way. I tried calling Maya as well and her phone’s going straight to voicemail too.
scene yumiinthelobbyyo30
: You expect me to just fuckin’ search the whole god damn city for her? This place is huge. There ain’t a chance in hell I’ll find her.
: Well, on the bright side, at least you have apparently unlimited time to actually do that.
scene yumiinthelobbyyo31
: You know, the cool part about bein’ in a possibly different world is that I could beat the fuck out of you without experiencing any consequences back in mine.
: Unless I can’t make it back, of course. But that’s a problem for future-Yumi. Or...past-Yumi? Either way, fuck off.
: I’m just trying to lighten the mood! I’m sure they’ll turn up eventually. We still have the entire second day of the Dorm Wars to go through and Ayane wouldn’t miss that for the world.
scene yumiinthelobbyyo32
: Or at least...ours wouldn’t? I’m not sure how yours would act comparatively. But assuming our base personalities don’t change-
: It’s whatever. Thanks for tryin’, Makoto. I’ll just fuckin’ go back home and sleep. Maybe service’ll be better in the morning or some shit.
scene yumiinthelobbyyo33
: You don’t want to stay here? The rooms are already paid for. And you could try asking everyone else about their memories if you think it’ll-
: Yeaaaah, nah. Think I’d rather just deal with livin’ in this world than riskin’ a conversation with any of them. Only reason I’m cool with you is cause you proved you ain’t that bad earlier.
: Oh. Well...thank you?
: No prob.
scene yumiinthelobbyyo34
: And if I don’t see ya again, stay away from that fuckin’ lowlife teacher. You hear me? Dude ain’t nothin’ but trouble and fuckin’ him ain’t gonna fix you. Got it?
: Okay. But if you do see me again, can I ask you to elaborate on any of that?
: Nope.
scene black
: Peace, four-eyes. Thanks again. Enjoy your fuckin’ sleepover. Hope the world doesn’t end in the middle of it and all that bullshit.
: Yumi! Where are you going?! I’m sad! This whole time, Karin has been secretly-
: Don’t care! Gotta go look for a blonde! Night!
: I’m right here, though! All you’ve ever wanted is right in front of-
: A natural one! Now, goodnight!
: Ugh! When will someone just love me for who I am?!
scene yumiinthelobbyyo35
And so Yumi Yamaguchi, a girl more involved in any of this than she ever intended or wanted, makes her way back out into the cool night air.
Despite it being summer here, she felt goosebumps on her arms and legs. But was it the air itself or nerves?
Or perhaps it was the brightly illuminated overhead reminders of how to use her mouth that put her on edge?
Whatever it was she felt, she didn’t want to feel it for much longer. But, at the same time, she couldn’t recall the last time she was this curious about anything.
Was she becoming more invested in this than she expected? Did having something to live for finally motivate her in some way?
Or were those goosebumps born of fear instead?
: Psst.
scene yumiinthelobbyyo36
: Hm?
scene yumiinthelobbyyo37
Because they should have been.
She did not belong in this world, so she was subject to removal.
But where would she go, I wonder?
And what would she see when she gets there?
: Hello, Friend.
scene black
: It’s been a while, hasn’t it?
